top_signals.title: Royal Caribbean Buys Stake in Sandals Resorts
top_signals.summary: Royal Caribbean Cruises agreed to buy a 50% stake in Sandals Resorts International for about $3 billion. Liana Baker has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
